title: CAR T-Cell Therapy Shows Lasting Improvements in Stiff Person Syndrome, Study at CU Anschutz Finds
summary:
The takeaway: 

A clinical trial at the University of Colorado Anschutz shows promising one-year results for an experimental CAR T-cell therapy for stiff person syndrome (SPS), a rare autoimmune neurological disease that causes severe muscle stiffness, spasms and difficulty walking. One year after a single treatment, patients completed a 25-foot walking test in nearly half the time, while two-thirds of those who previously needed walking aids completed the test without assistance.
